## Before you submit

Search [existing issues](https://github.com/OnlyPaul/MurMur/issues?q=is%3Aissue) for similar ideas first.

## The problem

What are you trying to do that Murmur doesn't currently support?

## The idea

A rough sketch of how you'd like it to work.

## Alternatives considered

Anything you've already tried, or other approaches that could solve the same problem.

## Notes

Anything else worth knowing — links, screenshots, related issues.
